item.text:
REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: High-impact approvals are authenticated to registered reviewer profiles but are not proven to cover the same proposed package. The validator neither compares the Sol and Opus review-package digests nor binds them to an authoritative digest for the change being accepted.
FINDING: critical|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|review_receipt.package_sha256 is checked only as part of each receipt digest; it is not compared across accepted reviews or against the current proposed package/patch|Sol and Opus approvals for different or obsolete packages can authorize another high-impact change, violating the required independent approval of that change
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Add an authoritative reviewed-package digest to provenance and require every accepted review receipt to match it; bind it to the proposed contract package/patch, and add failing fixtures for cross-review and current-package digest mismatches.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: A high-impact record contains a valid Sol receipt for package A and a valid Opus receipt for package B, with unique identities and correct receipt hashes; the current validator accepts the record even if the proposed change is package C.
